reviews.comment: A lot of homework (2-3 a week sometimes) but you will learn a lot from it and I never felt like it was anything not manageable. She is a great lecturer and the class is extremely organized and effective. Her exams can trip you up but nothing too bad (if you understand the HW's you will probably get an A or close to an A on an exam)

MANDATORY FOR STRUCTURAL TRACK - Professor Birely will teach you the material better than any other professor here and will set you up for later structural classes. There is a lot of homework and the tests are hard so I wouldn't recommend if you aren't structures track but she post all her lectures on zoom and that makes life a lot better.

She is a good teacher, you will learn a lot. However, her exams are very difficult, even if you know how to do everything. The exam is too much for the time we have left to finish it. Almost the whole class didn't finish in time. There is a reason why she has 20 Q-drops for every class.

She is the GOAT. I wish I had taken her for steel but extremely grateful to have had her for theory of structures. Her class is not easy but that doesn't matter because you will learn so much and is willing to help you when you need help. She offers a lot of office hours and is very accessible outside of class.

Dr. Birely was one of the best professors I have ever learned from in my time at A&M. Her teaching method and the quality of her lecture are exceptional. She is one of the few who I respect and find inspirational.

Prof was a great teacher, you will learn the content pretty well if you attend her lectures. She is never boring. Expect homework 2-3 times a week. The HWs cause burnout but honestly this is the quality education that we're here for. Work hard and you'll learn the content easily. Content is well organized; you'll know what to study for exams.

Dr. Birely is a great professor. Hard work is not enough to pass this class. She assigns so much homewok. Expect to do 4-6hours of homework at least for this class every week. Many people had to q-drop this class. Her exams are confusing and it feels like she does not care about her students being successful on the exams,

I loved Dr. Birely for 345. She made things easy to understand and she was good about answering student questions. She's a good lecturer as well; she isnt boring to listen to like many profs are She gives out shorter, but more frequent, HW assignments, which I felt helped me stay on top of things and not be able to procrastinate like I usually do.

Dr. Birely made CVEN 345 way too complex and impossible to keep up with if you even slacked a little. While her teaching style is respectable, it is very time consuming and unnecessarily in-depth. She expected everything to be as if we were still in person, and gave so much work. If you weren't doing well, she didn't seem to care about you at all.

Prof Birely was the best professor I've had at Texas A&M University. I learned so much from her. I went from having no experience with Matlab and matrix structural analysis, but now I feel like I have a thorough understanding of both topics. Take Prof Birely! She will challenge you, but it's worth it and I'm so happy because the hard work paid off.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Took Dr. Birely for CVEN 345 and thought she would be fantastic for CVEN 444. She did not disappoint. With posted notes, available office hours, and clear lectures, she is fantastic professor in CVEN 444. Really felt that I learned the material rather than just earned a grade.

It is a hard class, lots of concepts that aren't easy. She was very good at explaining the concepts and giving assignments that actually seem relevant to CVEN as a whole. Need to watch/ listen to lectures and do the homeworks and you will almost definitely pass. Would highly recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Birely is an outstanding professor through and through. While she does give a lot of homework, it is obvious that she genuinely cares. Her notes are a little rough, but between the homework solutions and the group projects, you really learn the material. If you want to know structures, this is the teacher for you.

Very sweet professor and not hard to follow along in class. Notes are posted online, but they are hard to follow and somewhat disorganized. Gives 2 homework assignments four days before they are due, and are not on a regular weekly bases (as in sometimes its due Sunday or Tuesday or Friday), so it's hard to plan on when and how to do you homework.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects
